get_keypoints: get the COCO keypoints list and their left/right flip correspondence map for pose estimation
flip_keypoints: flip keypoint coordinates horizontally using the COCO left/right flip map and image width
flip_heatmaps: flip keypoint heatmaps horizontally by swapping left/right channels and reversing spatial axis
heatmaps_to_keypoints: extract predicted keypoint locations from heatmaps and return x, y, logit, and prob values
compute_oks: compute object keypoint similarity between predicted and ground truth keypoints for COCO evaluation
